message:
All tests pass now (2 of 2). The only change is in `test/vat.test.js`.

The failing assertion was `withVat(250)` expecting 301. 20% VAT on 250p is 50p, so the total is 300p, and the source comment says the result is rounded to the nearest penny. `250 * 1.2` is exactly 300 in floating point, so the code was right and the expected value was wrong. I changed the expectation from 301 to 300 and left `src/vat.js` alone.

I did not commit the change.

claims.sentence: I changed the expectation from 301 to 300 and left `src/vat.js` alone.
